content.title: What is Plume about?
content.description: Plume is the first RWAfi L1 network focused on crypto natives, building infrastructure to connect the real world and crypto markets. It challenges the traditional view of RWAs by introducing new, crypto-first RWA use cases, including RWA derivatives, speculation, borrowing, lending, yield farming, and more, rather than simply replicating traditional finance on the blockchain.

content.title: PENGU is the official coin of Pudgy Penguins.
content.description: Pudgy Penguins has become the face of crypto with one of the most influential communities in the industry. From large companies wearing the Penguin, to being featured in ETF commercials, to garnering millions of followers and over 100 billion views, the Pengu has become a cultural icon making PENGU the world’s social currency.

content.title: What is Biconomy about?
content.description: Biconomy provides plug-n-play APIs to make web3.0 user-friendly & frictionless. Biconomy is on a mission to make the decentralized web accessible to everyone. We are the missing piece to crypto adoption for onboarding the next billion. Our APIs & SDKs transform any dApp to become usable for anyone regardless of their crypto knowledge and experience. Our multi-chain relayer infrastructure processes almost 50K daily transactions for 40+ DApps to ensure all the benefits of web3.0 come with the intuitiveness of web2.0.

content.title: What is Hyperliquid about?
content.description: Hyperliquid is a layer one (L1) blockchain best known for perpetual futures and spot trading. Beyond its flagship DEX trading platform, the ecosystem supports borrowing, lending, real world assets (RWAs), and a full-fledged Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM), making it a leading force in decentralized finance (defi).

content.title: About Pi Network (PI)
content.description: Pi Network is a social cryptocurrency and developer platform designed to make digital currency mining accessible to everyday people through mobile devices.

content.title: About Bless (BLESS)
content.description: Bless is a decentralized computing platform designed to transform the idle processing power of everyday consumer devices into a global, shared supercomputer.

content.title: About Sui (SUI)
content.description: Sui is a Layer 1 blockchain designed for global adoption by providing a high-speed and secure environment for digital asset ownership.

content.title: What is pump.fun?
content.description: Pump.fun is a Solana-based memecoin generator/launchpad that simplifies the process of creating tokens, allowing users to launch their own memecoins without needing technical expertise.

content.title: What is Squid about?
content.description: Squid is the cross-chain infrastructure layer that powers the movement of digital value across more than 100 blockchains and 20,000+ tokens. Instead of asking users to manage individual bridges, gas tokens and signatures, Squid collapses that complexity into a single intent — "send X, receive Y on chain Z" — routed across the full multichain surface and settled in one action. The product stack spans Squid Intents (the protocol layer, sub-5-second execution), the Squid Aggregator (routing across 130+ DEXs and off-chain liquidity sources), Squid Token Service and Accounts for abstraction, the Squid SDK for developers, and the live Squid Bridge. Coverage reaches 106+ chains across EVM, Cosmos, Bitcoin, Solana, XRPL and Hedera. QUID is the native token of the ecosystem, used for staking, priority product access and governance.

content.title: What is Kaspa (KAS)?
content.description: Kaspa was fair-launched in November 2021 with no pre-mine, zero pre-sale, and no coin allocations, and is 100 percent community-managed. Kaspa aims to be the world's global sequencer for traditional finance and decentralized crypto markets by utilizing proof-of-work and its BlockDAG consensus protocol, GHOSTDAG.
